stem: Which sentence should replace sentence 32 to bring this paper to a more effective conclusion?

options.label: A
options.text: The Hudson River School artists will always be known for their bravery, friendliness, and relaxed personalities.

options.label: B
options.text: And many Americans did just that as they settled across the United States and began to make homes for their families.

options.label: C
options.text: If you ever get a chance to see some of these paintings, you should take the time to appreciate their beauty.

options.label: D
options.text: No wonder the paintings of the Hudson River School remain some of the most beloved artwork ever produced.
